rapport_notes: Stayed warm and unflustered through a call with a very bad connection (customer breaking up repeatedly) and closed with genuine warmth.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "do you have any specific concerns or any important things that you wanted to answer during this call by any chance?" -- asked only after per-day rates had already been quoted and date/location probing had started.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer: "I just have to proceed... you know figure that out" -- no real concern surfaced.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "you're not locked in for four hours... even if they end up two and a half hours" -- pay-less-if-faster covered clearly.

top_strength: Kept the call on track and got every logistics detail despite a terrible phone connection, without losing patience.
coaching_note: Per-hour rates were quoted before the agenda/concerns question was ever asked -- move that question to immediately after the quid pro quo, before any pricing or logistics.
